description: Verify the settings entry in the dock icon right-click menu. The settings window itself is not opened because the frame probe cannot click the native QMenu.

assertions.comment: The right-click menu shows entries for the settings window and information page in the actual order.
assertions.pixel_exempt: The menu is built and its entries are read in-process, but Wayland only maps a popup for a real grabbing parent surface, so whether anything paints here is a race. Judged on the menu model, never on pixels.
